entry.title: Keyscope 1.0.4
entry.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. entry.title: Keyscope 1.0.2
entry.summary: ## What's new in 1.0.2 - **Works on MPC OS 2.x as well as 3.x.** The screen skin is now written in the MPC OS 2.x format, which 3.x reads too, so the touchscreen page draws on 2.x units instead of staying empty. Checked against MPC OS 2.15.1's own skins; not yet tried on a 2.x unit, so reports from 2.x owners are welcome. - The plugin itself is unchanged.
